title: feat: deterministic content validation and quality report for generated documents
body:
## Summary

Phase 1 of the multi-stage resume pipeline programme: every generated résumé and cover letter is now **deterministically validated against the candidate's own source document**, with the result persisted, surfaced in the UI, and available to the agent. The core rule made mechanical: the LLM decides HOW to present verified evidence — these validators catch it deciding WHAT.

- **`validate/content/`** (L1): 25-code deterministic validator family — factual (unsourced metrics/terms/dates, dropped roles, altered project links), alignment (coverage regression vs source, missing evidenced requirements), consistency (dates, title drift, skills claimed-but-not-demonstrated, project-structure tiers), duplicates, ATS structure + keyword-density, and a `voice.*` anti-AI-tell family (single-source lexicon shared with the generation prompts via codegen). Criticals come only from deterministic checks — a model can never emit one.
- **`documents/evidence.rs`** (L1): evidence extraction (`extract_evidence`/`rank_bullets`) — the `rank_trim_candidates` core moved out of the R8-frozen `match_resume.rs` (net −141 lines, trim-panel wire-compat pinned by test).
- **`quality_report` on `ai_generations`** (ADR-007 §F2): opaque wrapper JSON, per-top-level-key merge, full backup/restore round-trip, 256 KB clamps on both write paths.
- **`resume:validateContent` IPC** (5-step): server-side clamps, strict docKind, content-free spans (ADR-027).
- **Four agent Read tools**: `validate_resume`, `search_candidate_evidence`, `lookup_salary`, `get_trim_suggestions` — fenced, clamped, least-privilege-pinned; fence-tag registry + `tool_result` marker hardened against forgery (incl. nested-marker bypass).
- **`pnpm gen:prompts` codegen**: the anti-AI-tell lexicon is generated from `natural-voice.ts` into Rust with a CI drift gate — one source instructs the model and validates its output, guarded in both directions.
- **Renderer**: integrity badge + QualityReportPanel (evidence-first, guidance-framed, en+de), report-carrying saves, staleness via source-text hash, Re-check action, hand-edit nudge.

## Review trail

Five domain critics + a security review + a 3-pass `/review` ensemble with per-finding fresh-context verification ran before this PR. Every blocking finding was fixed with mutation-verified regression tests, including: six false-positive Criticals on truthful documents, a per-key merge defect, a forged-fence-tag hole, a renderer cancel race, a UTF-8 boundary panic on accented URLs (`café-berlin.de`) that would have aborted the app mid-generation, and a malformed-persisted-report renderer crash. Zero verifier-rejected findings; ledger updated.

## Test plan

- `cargo test --lib`: 3410 passed · `--test architecture`: 18/18 · clippy `-D warnings` clean
- Desktop vitest: 3074 passed · prompts 742 · workspace typecheck 13/13 · `lint:strict` clean
- `gen:ipc:check` + `gen:prompts:check` clean · backup/export round-trip covers the new column
- Fixtures include paraphrased-but-truthful en+de documents (zero-Critical guards) and accented-URL project entries
